notes: Each fixed seed resets Python, NumPy, and Torch RNGs, but batched categorical sampling consumes the Torch stream in a different order from scalar sampling, so trajectories and decision counts are distribution-comparable rather than pairwise identical.  The vector engine also partitions deck randomness into one independent stream per game.
The canonical differential suite separately proves exact rules, deck, hand-order, duplicate, terminal, and truncation equivalence under deterministic decisions across 128 seeds.
This machine exposed no CUDA device to the benchmark process; the recorded workload is CPU rollout and CPU PPO update.
